title: Spacetime curvature feels matter on neighboring trajectories

statements.text: The Einstein field equations are generalized so that curvature in our spacetime feels the energy-momentum of matter on neighboring trajectories of $I_U$, through a measure that smears the delta function of general relativity over a $p$-adic neighborhood. The modification reduces smoothly to general relativity as $p \rightarrow \infty$ and would likely prevent curvature singularities.

sources.quote: the curvature of space-time feels the energymomentum of matter fields in space-times associated with neighbouring trajectories
an extension of the Einstein field equations on $I_U$ is proposed which reduces smoothly to general relativity as $p \rightarrow \infty$
